subject: ClearVista — segmentation POA request & next steps (VPC vs Dedicated)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: ClearVista post-demo — segmentation expectations (quick POA ask)

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and three small asks so we can put together a constrained POA (proof-of-action) comparing Dedicated vs Private VPC for ClearVista.

Recap (what we heard):
- Primary requirement: strict logical separation of customer data + auditability for PHI-like datasets.
- Residency: US-only controls with potential requirement for an on-prem connector later.
- Encryption: customer-managed keys for persisted model artifacts and logs preferred.

Three asks to finalize the POA:
1) Can you confirm whether outbound network egress must traverse your managed firewall/proxy (Y/N)?
2) Does your security team require HSM-backed KMS or will KMS with Bring-Your-Own-Key suffice for pilot?
3) Is there a minimum SLA (uptime/latency) we should target for the pilot?

What we'll provide once we have answers: a two-page mini-POA that lists the configuration differences (control plane residency, KMS options, audit log retention, ops handover), an estimated cost delta for Dedicated vs Private VPC for a 3-month pilot, and an ops runbook for onboarding.

Attaching: SLA-draft-v1.pdf for initial SLA language and a one-page outline.

Next steps: if you can reply to the three asks above, we will turn around the POA by EOD Friday (5/22). If helpful, we can also set up a short 30-min technical deep-dive with Karthik and our Infra lead.

Thanks — Hannah

From: Daniel Park <daniel@clearvista.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearvista.com, legal@clearvista.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearVista post-demo — segmentation expectations (quick POA ask)

Hannah — thanks for the recap and for sending the draft SLA. Quick answers inline below.

1) Egress: Yes — all outbound traffic from vendor infra must egress through our managed firewall/proxy. We need either a static egress IP range or a proxy forwarder.
2) KMS: For the pilot, BYOK via cloud KMS (customer-managed keys) is acceptable. For production evaluation we will likely require HSM-backed keys.
3) SLA target: For pilot we can accept best-effort but production target is 99.9% monthly availability and P95 latency <120ms for token-generation paths.

A few additional notes from our security team (cc'd):
- We will need proof of encryption-at-rest and in-transit, plus a short description of how KV cache is handled for model state.
- Audit logs need 1 year retention with export capability to our SIEM.

We'll review the POA when you send it. Also please include a diagram that shows the control plane/network boundaries for both Dedicated and Private VPC options.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
CTO, ClearVista Labs
daniel@clearvista.com

Forwarding Daniel's answers and security asks. Notes / proposed approach: 

- Short POA contents (we will produce): 1) matrix comparing Dedicated vs Private VPC across custody, egress controls, KMS options, audit logs, and cost; 2) minimal infra diagram for each mode; 3) steps & owners for pilot onboarding (2–3 week window).
- For egress through ClearVista managed firewall we can support either: (a) static egress IP ranges from Dedicated pools, or (b) a NAT/proxy appliance in the Private VPC that tunnels to your proxy — flow will differ but both are feasible.
- KV cache: to satisfy audit and ephemeral-state requirements we can disable persistent KV caching and enable strict TTL-based in-memory-only caches for pilot; include this in the POA.
- KMS: propose BYOK cloud KMS for pilot; add optional HSM addendum for later.

Attachments I will prepare and include: mini-POA-clearvista.docx (POA + cost delta) and vpc-deployment-ops.pdf (ops diagram + checklist).

Action items: Hannah to send POA to Daniel + security + legal; Karthik will draft the infra diagram. Grace to prepare estimated cost delta for Dedicated vs Private for the requested pilot sizing.

- Alternate: Dedicated pooled capacity with static egress IPs and REDWOOD-managed control plane (fastest to start, lower setup cost). We list cost delta and timeline for both options.
